stem: The young revolutionary who, along with Rajguru and Sukhdev, was hanged in 1931 for his role in revolutionary activities against British rule, including throwing a (non-lethal) bomb in the Central Legislative Assembly to protest repressive laws, was:
explanation: Bhagat Singh, along with Rajguru and Sukhdev, was executed in 1931 following the Central Legislative Assembly bombing incident (1929) and the killing of British officer Saunders — a landmark event in the revolutionary strand of the freedom struggle, distinct from Chandrasekhar Azad (died in a separate encounter) or Subhas Chandra Bose (led the INA).
